videos.title: Install Radar
videos.caption: Open the disk image and drag Radar into Applications.

videos.title: Add your API keys
videos.caption: Settings → paste keys → Save. You only need OpenRouter plus one social provider.

videos.title: Create a watchlist and run a sweep
videos.caption: Name, what it is about, keywords, platforms, then Run sweep.

videos.title: Reports and email digest
videos.caption: Generate a digest now, or set Daily / Weekly on Reports.
